From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Thanks — I’ll take point for the legal redlines. High-level notes after a first pass on BB_MSA_v1.0.docx:

1) Data Processing & Residency: The MSA references "Customer data" but there is no DPA attached. We’ll request the DPA and propose an addendum that sets clear retention windows and subprocessors. If BlueBell requires EU residency for certain datasets, we’ll surface the regional deployment options and costs.

2) Liability / Indemnity: The vendor-friendly indemnity and uncapped consequential damages clauses need follow-up. We typically propose a balanced liability cap tied to fees or a multiple thereof.

3) Security Evidence: Please provide SOC 2 Type II report or link. If you can’t share the full report, a security questionnaire or SOC snapshot will do for initial procurement review.

4) SLA language: The SLOs in the Order Form are high-level. Jonas — can you confirm whether the throughput metrics map to reserved vs burst capacity so we can propose objective failure definitions?

Priority for first-pass redlines (we’ll flag & propose language inline): data processing / DPA, liability cap, confidentiality definitions.

I’ll prepare a redline PDF and a short comment matrix by Tuesday morning.

- Marissa
Director, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
